learning_record.narrative: TruckRoute Pro failed to achieve traction in logistics software market despite 32 weeks of operation. Core GTM hypothesis (direct-to-shipper sales model) was disproven by consistent low conversion rates (3% at industry standard 8-12% for logistics SaaS). Customer acquisition cost of $2,800 exceeded lifetime value of $3,600 by 1.8x ratio. Team was stretched with limited logistics domain expertise. Market showed higher switching costs and stronger competitive entrenchment than initially assessed. Key learning: supply chain software requires deep domain expertise and customer relationships before product investment. Geographic focus on US freight didn't differentiate sufficiently.
